answer_verbatim:
The **best online courses** for learning shadow work and spiritual practice depend on whether you want a **Jungian, structured, or more spiritually oriented** approach. Based on the available course descriptions, the strongest options are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow***, **ManTalks’ Shadow Course**, and **Awake Academy’s *Embracing the Shadow*** for a deeper, guided practice; **Udemy’s *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self*** and **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** are more accessible, practical starting points.[2][19][20][3][12]

- **Best for Jungian depth:** *Encounters with the Shadow* on Jung Platform is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology course series.[9][16]
- **Best for guided spiritual integration:** ManTalks’ **Shadow Course** is an 8-week guided process focused on facing and integrating the shadow, which makes it a strong fit if you want a spiritual-development framing.[19]
- **Best for transformational self-work:** Awake Academy’s **Embracing the Shadow** is presented as highly transformative by a participant testimonial, suggesting a more immersive personal-growth experience.[20]
- **Best beginner-friendly option:** Udemy’s **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** emphasizes healing, hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening, making it a straightforward entry point.[3]
- **Best for exercises and practices:** Udemy’s **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices, which is useful if you want a more hands-on spiritual workbook format.[12]
- **Best structured diploma-style course:** Centre of Excellence’s **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** is framed as a Jungian-inspired reflective journey with a diploma structure.[4]
- **Best for live interaction:** Catherine Liggett’s **Shadow Work 101** is a 5-week live online course via Zoom, which may suit learners who prefer real-time guidance.[7]

If you want a simple shortlist:

| Goal | Best pick |
|---|---|
| Jungian theory and depth | Jung Platform: *Encounters with the Shadow* |
| Spiritual shadow integration | ManTalks: *Shadow Course* |
| Beginner-friendly, practical start | Udemy: *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self* |
| Exercises, meditations, prayers | Udemy: *Shadow Work Course and Workbook* |
| Live coaching/community | Catherine Liggett: *Shadow Work 101* |

If your goal is specifically **shadow work plus spiritual practice**, the most aligned choices from the results are **ManTalks Shadow Course**, **Udemy’s Shadow Work Course and Workbook**, and **Udemy’s Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** because they explicitly connect shadow integration with spiritual growth, meditations, prayers, or awakening language.[19][12][3]
